labels.note: Key absent from links implies absent from data; both paths end in __missing__(key).
Iteration yields items exactly at expiry time; boundary off-by-one observable with mock timer.
Missing key yields __missing__ either directly or via Cache.__getitem__; same outcome.
Skipped count merges keys with different frequencies into one bucket, causing wrong LFU eviction.
Heap cleanup drops live items; they never expire and vanish from iteration, corrupting cache.
